# Bakerï

> Bakerï is an all-in-one creator-commerce and business-management platform for independent creators, food entrepreneurs and makers. It combines a branded storefront and link in bio, online checkout, order management, customer relationships and mailing lists, digital products and courses, memberships, and business tools such as recipe management, ingredient costing and scheduling. Bakerï is available on the web (bakeriapp.com/app) and as an iOS app.

Bakerï supports three ways to sell: **Food** (ready-made products, preorders and custom requests for bakers, confectioners, caterers and specialty food producers), **Digital** (recipes, downloads, courses, guides and memberships for creators and educators) and **Physical** (handcrafted goods, merchandise and shipped products for makers and artisans).

Bakerï is not a marketplace and does not find customers for its users. Each business gets its own storefront and owns its customer relationships, instead of depending on third-party marketplaces or social media algorithms.

Pricing (USD): Starter is $10/month plus a 5% commission on online sales; Pro is $30/month with no sales commission. Both plans include a 7-day free trial.

- [Blog](https://bakeriapp.com/blog/): articles from Bakerï.
- [Referral program](https://bakeriapp.com/referral-program.html): earn 20% recurring commission on vendors you refer.
- [Community Growth Partners](https://bakeriapp.com/community-growth-partners.html): apply to introduce food makers to Bakerï and earn recurring commission, with a partner dashboard (no shop needed).
